violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the 3 COMPARTMENT SINK piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. CFM STATED WORK ORDER HAS ALREADY BEEN PLACED AND IS WAITING ON REPAIR.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED DEBRIS UNDERNEATH CABINETS AND FLOORS IN FRONT KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CLEAN FLOORS BEHIND AND UNDERNEATH EQUIPMENT DAILY.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. Observed employees preparing food without hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. Employees donned hair nets.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HAND SINK AT KIOSK AT 68F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. CFM CONTACTING UPPER MANAGEMENT TO ADDRESS ISSUE. EHS WILL RETURN IN 10 DAYS TO VERIFY HOT WATER IS ABLE TO REACH 100F.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELL EGGS ON SHELF ABOVE RTE TOPPINGS IN WIC (BACK STORAGE AREA).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EMPLOYEE MOVED RAW SHELL EGGS TO BOTTOM SHELF.
